hooks.command: p=$(command -v orbit-mem 2>/dev/null) || p="$HOME/.local/bin/orbit-mem"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" hook pre-tool --host claude --plugin-version 0.17.1; fi
p=$(command -v orbit-mem 2>/dev/null) || p="$HOME/.local/bin/orbit-mem"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" hook session-end --host claude --plugin-version 0.17.1; fi

p=$(command -v orbit-mem 2>/dev/null) || p="$HOME/.local/bin/orbit-mem"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" hook session-start --host claude --plugin-version 0.17.1; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"additionalContext":"orbit-mem 실행 파일이 PATH와 ~/.local/bin 어디에도 없습니다. https://github.com/crispebble/orbit-mem 안내대로 설치한 뒤 `orbit-mem install`을 실행하세요.","hookEventName":"SessionStart"}}'; fi
p=$(command -v orbit-mem 2>/dev/null) || p="$HOME/.local/bin/orbit-mem"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" hook subagent-start --host claude --plugin-version 0.17.1; fi
p=$(command -v orbit-mem 2>/dev/null) || p="$HOME/.local/bin/orbit-mem"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" hook prompt --host claude --plugin-version 0.17.1; fi
